about:
Bridgelux operates from Fremont, California, as a vertically integrated LED chip manufacturer. The company's founding year is not publicly disclosed in the provided sources. Leadership includes CEO Yiqun Li, who has spoken on high-CRI LEDs and RGBW lighting. Ownership structure and founder names are not specified in the available information.

The company produces LED components ranging from epitaxial wafers to complete light engines. Its product portfolio includes the Bridgelux Strip Series for architectural and commercial applications, the RGBW Series for color-mixing solutions, the F90™ platform that achieves high color rendering without sacrificing efficacy, and the Thrive™ line designed to mimic natural sunlight. The vertical integration spans wafer fabrication, chip processing, and light-engine assembly, though facility size, headcount, and annual volumes are not disclosed.

Bridgelux serves the LED lighting industry with a focus on architectural, commercial, and outdoor segments. Recent product launches target flexible linear lighting, high-power outdoor luminaires, and tunable-white plus RGBW color-mixing applications. Customers include lighting OEMs and fixture manufacturers seeking high-CRI, high-efficacy LED platforms, though specific client names are not provided.

The company emphasizes its vertical integration as a core differentiator, enabling control from epitaxy through to packaged light engines. The F90™ technology addresses the traditional trade-off between CRI and efficacy, while Thrive™ aims to replicate the spectral quality of natural light. These platforms are positioned to give customers a competitive advantage in light quality and design flexibility.
